body:
Objective: Review the new Certifications section added to src/pages/cv/index.astro for code quality, design consistency, and correctness. Context: A builder just added a certifications section to the CV page. Changes include: - New `certifications` const array in frontmatter (after `experience` array) - New Certifications `
` between Experience and CTA sections - Each card: cert image (plain ``), issuer (mono accent label), title, date, "Verify on Coursera →" link - JSON-LD schema updated with `hasCredential` entries - Images moved to public/images/coursera-cybersecurity.png and public/images/coursera-golang.png Review criteria: 1. **Design consistency**: Does the new section match existing section patterns (technicalStack, coreProjects, experience)? Check card classes, section classes, heading styles, spacing, label styles. Any visual mismatches? 2. **Image handling**: Are images sized/styled well? `max-w-md` on cert images — will they look good in the card layout? Consider if images might be too large or awkwardly sized relative to card. 3. **Code quality**: Clean code? Follows existing conventions? Any duplication or issues? 4. **Correctness**: Links correct? Target/rel attributes present? JSON-LD schema valid? 5. **Responsive**: Will cards look good on mobile? Images responsive? 6. **Accessibility**: Alt text present? Link text descriptive enough? Deliverables: - List any issues found (with file:line refs) - Rate design consistency with rest of page (good/matches vs needs adjustment) - Suggest specific improvements if any Prerequisites: Read src/pages/cv/index.astro fully. Compare new certifications section against existing sections for consistency.
